slides.title: MEET PERPLEXITY
slides.body: The AI answer engine that searches the web, finds sources, and gives you a direct answer instead of making you dig through ten tabs.

slides.title: START WITH A QUESTION
slides.body: Ask a real question in plain English. Perplexity searches current information and brings the answer together with citations you can open and verify.

slides.title: WHAT MAKES IT USEFUL?
slides.body: Research faster • Follow-up questions keep context • Sources appear with answers • Great for comparisons, current events, product research, and learning.

slides.title: USE IT LIKE A RESEARCH ASSISTANT
slides.body: Try: Compare these 3 tools for a solo creator. Then ask what changed this month. Finish by asking for the 5 most important takeaways with sources.

slides.title: THE TAKEAWAY
slides.body: Don't just ask AI to write. Use it to find, compare, verify, and compress information. Save this carousel and follow @skilledtechie for the next AI tool.
